prompts.name: birch
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production sprite for a cozy 2.5D farming game. A SINGLE isolated object, entire silhouette centered with 8 percent padding, visible base bottom center. Fixed orthographic isometric view down 35 degrees, soft sunlight upper left. Rich painterly hand-crafted 3D-rendered illustration, natural materials and crisp readable silhouette. Genuinely transparent alpha background, no ground tile, no floor, no cast ground shadow, no landscape, no other objects, no text or border. A slender silver birch tree with two graceful white trunks marked dark gray, small delicate leaves in airy lime green and olive clusters, narrow upright canopy, small exposed roots. Clearly different silhouette from a broad oak.
